title: A new Evia update is ready
details: Trowel Occupations Level 3 (6570-05) is now available with all eight mandatory units and the learner's selected optional unit
All official assessment criteria are mapped holistically into practical and theory evidence themes while the exact Unit, learning outcome and AC references stay underneath
Trowel Occupations uses TOC, AC, GLH and Units progress and does not use an EPA mock
